children.name: Rickettsia rickettsii
children.description: Rickettsia rickettsii is a Gram-negative, intracellular, cocco-bacillus bacterium that was first discovered in 1896.

children.name: Rickettsia felis
children.authorship: Bouyer et al. 2001 emend. La Scola et al. 2002

children.name: Rickettsia conorii
children.description: Rickettsia conorii is a Gram-negative, obligate intracellular bacterium of the genus Rickettsia that causes human disease called boutonneuse fever, Mediterranean spotted fever, Israeli tick typhus, Astrakhan spotted fever, Kenya tick typhus, Indian tick typhus, or other names that designate the locality of occurrence while having distinct clinical features.

children.name: Rickettsia montanensis
children.authorship: corrig. (ex Lackman et al. 1965) Weiss and Moulder 1984

children.name: Orientia tsutsugamushi
children.description: Orientia tsutsugamushi (from Japanese tsutsuga meaning "illness", and mushi meaning "insect") is a mite-borne bacterium belonging to the family Rickettsiaceae and is responsible for a disease called scrub typhus in humans.
